messages:
mike: spotting a spike in 503s across eu-west-1 since 09:07 UTC, looks correlated with the canary traffic. holding all outbound deploys for the next window :eyes:
anya: ack, thanks. can we pin the [v2-search] rollout so it doesn't auto-continue?
deploybot: deploybot invoked: create_hold --scope=all --reason=incident-eu-503 --initiator=@mike
deploybot: HOLD created (id=hb-2024-09-eu-503). All scheduled deploys in the next 2 hours suspended.
ops-oncall: seeing increased tail latency on control-plane instances too, raising priority. will investigate infra side.
mike: decision: no automatic rollback for canary yet, but we should stop progressing any new lanes. can someone post a suggested recovery/reschedule timeline?
kevin: propose: 30m triage, if root cause >= DB-related then extend hold and plan for slot reshuffle in next 4-hour change window. if config or kernel-related, aim for 90-min hotfix.
anya: noted. updating release notes and pinging stakeholders (sales/support) now. copying in the current pinned commits for v2-search: `git rev-parse --short HEAD` -> `f3a1b9c`
anya: adding release note snippet: "Hold due to eu-west-1 503 spike; deploys paused while infra triage is ongoing. Expected update in ~30m."
ops-oncall: found a noisy rollback job hitting the control plane API and exhausting connections. killing job id 3421 reduced error rate by ~40% in the last 4m.
mike: ok that helps. still want to keep release pinned for now. can we reschedule the queued releases into the 02:00-04:00 UTC window as a fallback?
deploybot: schedule_shift invoked: move_queue --target-window=02:00-04:00UTC --reason="post-incident-reschedule" --confirm-by=@kevin
kevin: confirmed. doing a soft requeue, preserving original priority ordering. I'll post updated slot allocations in 10m.
anya: noted we need ops sign-off before any resume. also we should mark these releases with a notes tag: `incident-reschedule-eu503` so analytics and billing are clean.
mike: add a canary-only test ramp when resuming: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation steps. include automatic rollback triggers on 5xx > 1%/5m or latency p95 > 600ms.\eops: (reaction :thumbsup:)
deploybot: queue moved. Releases rescheduled: 14 items -> window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pin applied to v2-search (f3a1b9c). Resume policy: manual ops sign-off required.\ops-oncall: will validate control-plane post-cleanup and report back in 25m.
kevin: FYI - I'll update the internal release tracker and send a short blurb to the on-call rotation so everyone knows the resumed plan.
mike: thanks team. keep this thread for updates only. if we go to rollback, call it explicitly and include SHIPSTOP.
anya: will do. publishing short note to #customer-ops now and attaching link to this thread"
